headline: Trump says the U.S. and Iran will meet in Qatar after weekend attacks
context: President Trump said talks with Iran would resume Tuesday in Qatar, despite the two sides trading attacks in the Gulf over the weekend. Iran did not confirm whether it will participate.

sources.name: NPR
